examples.text:
Không có việc gì khó;
Chỉ sợ lòng không bền.
Đào núi và lấp biển,
Quyết chí ắt làm nên.
examples.translation:
No task is hard;
Fear only an unenduring heart!
Undermining mountains and filling up seas,
Determination will surely guarantee success.

examples.text: Chả hiểu nó đang nói ất giáp cái giống gì.
examples.translation: Yeah as if I understand jack all about what he's spouting.

examples.text: Mới đi có chút mà thằng ất ơ nào chiếm chỗ rồi.
examples.translation: I was just gone for a bit but some random dude already took my place.

glosses: dim-witted or having a few screws loose
The forty-second term of the Chinese sexagenary cycle, sometimes glossed as "Wood Snake" from its associated terms in the Chinese elements and zodiac.
initialism of an toàn khu (“(revolutionary) safe haven”)
